description: Accept Bitcoin payments. Free, open-source & self-hosted, Bitcoin payment processor.
readme_summary: BTCPay Server is a free and open-source, self-hosted Bitcoin payment processor. It lets merchants accept Bitcoin directly, without fees or intermediaries. - **Users:** Use BTCPay Server - **Operators:** Deploy and operate BTCPay Server - **Developers:** Build integrations and plugins - **Maintainers:** Maintain this repository See the documentation gateway for more audience-specific resources. Website | Documentation | Greenfield API | Demo | Issues | Discussions | Community chat Security vulnerabilities must be reported through the process in SECURITY.md, not as public issues.
